title: Transfer | Warehouse Dock Slot Constraint Parser
goal: Read carrier scheduling messages and extract loading dock appointment constraints into `/root/dock_slot_constraints.json`, including arrival windows, no-arrival intervals, required slot length, date flexibility, and cutoff-time constraints for same-day unloading.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the skill to logistics coordination, a clearly different domain that still depends on precise extraction of scheduling constraints from free-form messages.
